prompt: Can we increase vacuum cleaner suction power?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 directly answers the question with a coherent set of practical, mostly accurate steps (maintenance, clearing airflow blockages, replacing worn parts, and cautious upgrades). Candidate 2 includes several clearly incorrect and potentially harmful suggestions (e.g., benefiting from a full bag, using sandpaper on filters, and boosting performance with magnets), so it fails on factual reliability. Candidate 3 is largely derailed by fantastical/implausible claims (rare platinum/iridium motor enhancements, “crystalline power core,” and incorrect electrical specifics), despite getting a couple basics right. Candidate 4 provides some reasonable ideas (cleaning/air sealing and cautious voltage upgrade warnings) but also includes at least one misleading technical explanation about variable motor speed reducing suction.
